name: Qaida for Beginners
description: A step-by-step beginner course that teaches you how to read Arabic, starting with recognizing and pronouncing the letters. Through structured lessons you'll understand the basic reading rules, see how letters connect to form words, and build the foundation you need to begin reading the Quran. Completing this course gives you a solid base for reciting the Quran with correct tajweed, and it also suits anyone hoping to learn Qaida For Beginner online.

name: Quran Reading for Beginners
description: The next stage after Qaida. This course focuses purely on reciting the Quran, with no translation or memorization, using the reading skills you already learned. Your tutor supports you through the entire Quran, and by the end you'll be able to read it fluently with tajweed.

name: Quran Memorization
description: An online program for memorizing the Holy Quran with the help of your tutor. The course has three levels: you start with short chapters and well-known verses, and your ability to memorize and retain the Quran is checked before you move on. Once you complete the first level, you progress through the second and third.

name: Islam for Kids
description: A complete Islamic Studies course for children aged 4 to 12. It's designed to help kids bring Islamic values into their daily routine by following the example of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), based on the Quranic verse that presents him as the perfect model to follow. It's also ideal for families new to Islam who want to combine Islamic studies with Quran reading from the comfort of home.

name: Quran with Tajweed & Tarteel
description: Learn the rules of tajweed so you can recite the Quran with correct pronunciation and a steady, moderate pace. This course covers how to say words properly, where to pause and continue (fasl and wasl), and how to recite slowly with clear letters. By the end, you'll be able to beautify your recitation and read the Quran the way it should be read.

name: Basic Fiqh Learning
description: An Islamic Studies course for children aged 7 to 12. Its aim is to help kids arrange their daily lives around Islamic teachings by following the sunnah of the Prophet (PBUH). Guided by the Quranic reminder that the Prophet is the finest example to follow, the course motivates children to live the Islamic way of life. It's equally suited to new Muslims wanting Islamic studies along with Quran reading.

name: Sirat Un-Nabi
description: This course introduces children to the life, character, and beautiful example of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Through his beliefs, manners, and conduct, kids learn the essential qualities that help them become good Muslims. It's a wonderful way for your children to learn about the Prophet's (PBUH) life and be inspired to follow in his footsteps.

name: Hadith Learning
description: A course that brings the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) into your child's everyday life. Students learn the etiquettes and good character modeled by the Prophet (PBUH), supported by the Quranic verse describing him as the best example for all of humanity. With practical examples, children are encouraged to walk in his footsteps.

name: Kids Islamic Stories
description: Enjoyable moral and prophetic stories that teach children valuable life lessons. Each class uses short, fun, and entertaining videos that bring the stories to life. Your child will learn the values of compassion, respect, integrity, and responsibility, and what it takes to be a good and considerate person.

name: Sala'at and Dua
description: Learn how to perform salah correctly, including memorizing the surahs you need for prayer. The course also teaches the duas to recite after prayer, how to perform wudu and ghusl, and the different kinds of prayers and related rulings. By the end, you'll be able to pray five times a day with confidence and proper method.

name: Quran for Kids
description: A complete and well-planned course that gives kids a strong foundation in Quran reading and Islamic studies. The curriculum covers Quranic education, Islamic knowledge, and Islamic manners and morals, all shaped around the way young learners actually learn best. Our Best Start program gives children a great beginning, with the resources and direction they need to start their Quranic journey.

name: Basic Qaida
description: A foundational course for adults who want to learn to read Arabic. Through structured lessons you'll learn to recognize and pronounce the Arabic alphabet and its symbols, understand the basic rules, and see how letters join together to form words. This course equips you with the essential skills to begin reading the Quran, and on completion you'll have a solid base for reciting with tajweed.

name: Quran Recitation
description: The second step for beginners learning to read the Quran. This course is all about recitation, with no translation or memorization, building on the reading skills you gained from Qaida. Your tutor helps you work through the whole Quran so you finish able to recite it fluently and correctly with tajweed.

name: Salaat and Dua
description: This course teaches you the method of performing salah, along with memorizing the surahs you need. You'll also learn the duas to recite after prayer, how to perform wudu and ghusl, and the different types of prayers and related matters. When you finish, you'll be able to perform salah correctly five times a day.

name: Tafseer-ul-Quran
description: Designed for students who can already read the Quran; if you're a beginner, it's recommended to start with Basic Qaida first. This course enables you to actually understand the entire Quran. Experienced instructors help you grasp the meaning of the verses and get you deeply engaged in Quranic teachings.

name: Understand Quran
description: Learn the word-by-word translation of Quranic verses along with the basic rules of grammar. The aim is to help you understand the Arabic text of the Quran for yourself. Since Arabic is the language of worship in Islam, this knowledge lets you offer your prayers with full awareness of what you're saying.

name: Islamic Beliefs and Practices (For new Muslims)
description: A systematic program for those who have recently embraced Islam. Along with the beliefs and practices, you'll gain an academic understanding of the Quran and the Hadith, the life of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), the political and cultural history of Islam, and the lives and works of the Companions. On the practical side, you'll learn to perform salat and hajj, observe fasting and give zakat, read and understand the Quran, memorize short surahs, and establish yourself in the Muslim community.

name: Tafseer-e-Quran
description: For students who can already read the Quran, this course goes deeper into understanding its meaning. Beginners are advised to start from Basic Qaida before enrolling. Taught by experienced instructors, the course helps you understand the teachings of the Quran and develop a deeper connection with Quranic knowledge.

name: Online Arabic Language Course
description: An Arabic course for non-native speakers that teaches you to communicate in the language. It covers extensive material and vocabulary from all areas of everyday life, from home and school to colleges, universities, markets, airports, and offices, so you can apply what you learn in real situations. Students also have the chance to join group classes where they practice speaking Arabic with fellow learners under the supervision of their tutor.

name: Urdu Language
description: Now you can learn Urdu reading, writing, and speaking in a simple and effective way. Enjoy interactive classes taught by native Urdu-speaking teachers, with modern teaching techniques used throughout the course.

name: Blessings of Ramadan
description: Explore the blessings of Ramadan and the practical rulings connected to fasting and worship. By the end of the course, you'll have a clear understanding of how to make the most of this sacred month, inshaAllah.

name: Tafseer for Women
description: A Tafseer course created specifically for women, helping them understand the Quran through explanation and interpretation. It covers selected verses on faith, character, family life, and personal development, offering practical lessons that women can apply in their daily lives.

name: Seerah of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
description: A course on the life of Prophet Muhammad (SAW), covering his character, struggles, and achievements. Students learn about his childhood, his prophethood, the challenges he faced, and the lessons from his life that guide us in our daily lives.

name: Hadith-e-Nabwi (SAW)
description: Explore selected hadith that capture the key teachings of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) on faith, character, morality, and daily life. Students learn the meaning and wisdom behind these hadith and how to apply them in their personal lives.
